AVENUE', 'MARYLAND' (+ AVE. further east), 'CHATEAU' + 'AVE.', 'SUMMIT' + 'AVE.', 'MT. HOPE' + 'RD.', 'MORROW ... PL.', 'PRICE ... AVENUE', 'STREET' along the bottom (W. EIGHTH further east). UNCERTAIN NAME: Ring Place. The curving narrow street from Grand around to the oval park (block 35) is printed only 'RING'; the straight SE leg from the park toward Glenway is printed only 'PLACE' (east of this strip, x~3950-4000); addresses run on continuously (2615 near Grand ... 2594, 2588, 2584 ... 2546, 2525, 2513), so the whole street is recorded as 'Ring Place'. Around the oval park it splits into two branches (north branch with addresses 2584-2550, south branch 2566-2556); the south branch is recorded as 'Ring Place (south branch)'. Hawthorne Avenue is in two offset sections: the north section (x~1769) runs from Liberty to Glenway; the south section (x~1673) runs from Warsaw to 8th (60' and 50' labels near Price). Grand drifts slightly (2205 at the top, 2199 at the bottom). Glenway: at Wing the E-W Glenway Avenue turns ESE onto a 60 ft diagonal (printed GLENWAY further SE) while Sterrett Avenue continues straight east on the same line; Wing ends there. Maryland Avenue: straight ESE from Grand to Summit, then curves SE through a wide gore where Morrow Place (east) and Mt. Hope Road (south) come in, then runs straight SE (60 ft) past the overlap edge; points there carry ~15-20 px. West 8th Street's south line is the plate's bottom neat line (y~5723 at x 1700, ~5705 at x 2700-3500); centre taken between it and the block line (y~5643-5650), as on 26a. Price Avenue is about 76 px (printed 80 east of Hawthorne, 60 printed just west of Hawthorne at (1625,5072)). Warsaw's interior lines are streetcar tracks and pipes. Not streets: boundary bands (green/yellow/pink/orange/grey), the 12 in. sewer strip across lots 1-3 north of Underwood, the dashed lot lines behind lots 52-58 north of the park, the oval park itself, the narrow strip between lot 58 and the yellow band SW of the west park junction.
